title: setRoute accepts tokenIn == tokenOut and paths with internal zero-gap segments — relies entirely on off-chain verification
story: Carry-forward of LOCAL-008; CurveAMMAdapter unchanged by story-042 (contract-profile confirms no diff in src/AMMAdapters/ between 043ff2c and 5f9abdd). Surfaced fresh this run via convergent slither+aderyn+profiler+code-scanner signals.
description: CurveAMMAdapter.setRoute validates only (a) tokenIn != 0, (b) tokenOut != 0, (c) path[0] == tokenIn, and (d) the LAST non-zero entry in path equals tokenOut. It does NOT check: (i) tokenIn != tokenOut; (ii) that path is contiguously non-zero (e.g. [tokenIn, 0, pool, 0, tokenOut, 0, ...] with internal zero gap passes); (iii) that swapParams matrix or pools array are consistent with the path topology. SA-005 flagged the uninitialized address lastToken at L74 — functionally safe today because path[0]!=0 guarantees lastToken is at least tokenIn, but the broader validation gap is real. Verification is fully delegated to off-chain procedures (per submodule CLAUDE.md AMM Route Configuration section).
impact: No direct theft (Curve Router NG enforces minAmountOut at the AMM and the strategy layer applies a NAV-anchored minOut on top). Realistic bad outcome: strategy DoS — deposit/withdraw/skimSurplus revert until the operator corrects setRoute. Availability impact bounded by time-to-fix. Configuration integrity only; owner-only setter — same trust boundary as the rest of the centralization bundle.
attackPath: 1. Operator (or off-chain deployment script) submits a malformed route to setRoute: e.g. tokenIn == tokenOut, or path = [tokenIn, 0, pool, 0, tokenOut, 0, ...] with an internal zero gap.
2. setRoute's validation passes (only checks path[0] == tokenIn and last non-zero entry == tokenOut).
3. First swap against the malformed route reverts at the Curve router or produces zero output; strategy operations dependent on the route DoS until operator re-runs setRoute with corrected payload.
assumptions: Operator may submit a typo or copy-paste error in route deployment payload.
externalRequirements: Off-chain script or operator submits malformed route via setRoute.
recommendation: Defense-in-depth additions to setRoute: (a) require(tokenIn != tokenOut, 'identity-route'); (b) walk the path validating (token, pool, token, pool, ..., token, 0*) interleave invariant; (c) at minimum reject paths that contain a zero between two non-zero slots. Per feedback_revert_over_silent_clamp.md, on-chain require/revert is the correct defense-in-depth (off-chain deferral does not auto-OOS the gap).
